artifacts.summary: Confirms line_count is consumed by budget-calculation scripts (rules out dropping it); recommends a report-and-repair auto-fix using the existing generate-context-line-counts.sh --write, following the validate-artifact.sh --fix precedent. Confirms the batch-stall root cause in orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's redeploy checkpoint (baseline-tolerance branch unreachable on deploy-headless.sh exit 3) and identifies command-gate-out.sh's existing rc==6 handler as a working precedent implementing the exact (a)/(b)/(c) split needed, ready to port. Flags that the third 'stale consumer repos' confound does not reproduce from static reading of current deploy-headless.sh (guarded with || true) and recommends a runtime check before the plan designs a fix for it.

memory_candidates.content: command-gate-out.sh's postflight completion-deploy-gate handler (rc==6 branch) already implements a reusable (a)/(b)/(c) pattern for distinguishing deploy-headless.sh's exit 1/2 (deploy failed, unconditional defer) from exit 3 (deploy landed but verify-deploy.sh reported failures, fall through to a pre/post --findings baseline comparison via comm -13). Any future site needing to decide whether to tolerate a pre-existing vs. newly-introduced verify-deploy.sh failure after a deploy-headless.sh call should port this exact pattern rather than reinventing it.

generate-context-line-counts.sh already implements wc -l based --check/--write regeneration for index-entries.json line_count fields, doing a surgical line-oriented text substitution (not a jq round-trip) specifically to keep diffs reviewable. Any future 'stop hand-maintaining a derived integer' task in this codebase should check for an existing regenerator script of this shape before writing new counting logic.
